sample_unit: participants (654,343 FFA images used for model development)

links.outcome: Ophthalmologist-rated accuracy, completeness, and harm of AI-generated answers to FFA questions
links.effect: 70.7% of answers error-free, 84.0% complete, 93.7% harmless; about 29% contained errors. 68.3% of reports high accuracy, 62.3% high completeness.
links.quote: In the manual QA evaluation, the consensus among the three ophthalmologists was that the majority of answers were characterized by high accuracy, completeness, and safety (70.7% as error-free, 84.0% as complete, and 93.7% as harmless).

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates FFA-GPT for report generation and visual QA on fundus fluorescein angiography images using automated metrics and an offline clinician manual grading study (assessing accuracy, completeness, and safety/harm).
